description:
Hushfeed v0.18.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: press and hold a story to save it, press and hold a profile picture to save the full size original, a switch for the searches TikTok offers before you type, and shared links can go through a host of your choosing.

From 0.17.0, which was not published on its own: patching fits the memory Morphe Manager gives by default, the settings screen speaks Indonesian, a video's sound can be saved as its own .m4a, and an animated sticker can be saved as MP4, GIF or the WebP TikTok sent. The default set of patches now finishes in 512 MB instead of 768; AMOLED dark theme rewrites colours and still needs 768.

Validation: 277 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle carries 64 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads; 63 of them applied to a stock 46.2.3 APK in one run, the miss being the known Downloads fingerprint. Phone installation has not been verified.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
